insight.label: $6.244 is high
insight.methodology: Insights are based on Los Angeles-Long Beach AAA metro gas prices observed from this daily tracker. Until enough daily history is collected, we bootstrap the range using AAA's current, yesterday, week-ago, month-ago, and year-ago comparison points. We classify prices as low, typical, or high based on where today's regular price sits relative to the observed range and typical middle band.

recommendation.summary: Prices are high and trending up, so filling today is safer if you need gas soon.
recommendation.reason: Regular is $0.140 above last week and $0.196 above last month. It sits in the high zone of the observed price range.
